listing.name: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition (GemRB)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Official GemRB SourceForge desktop archives, Flatpak, or documented source build; provide original supported Infinity Engine installation and configure GamePath or positional game directory. Enhanced Edition support kept separate. Limits: Experimental BG2EE support; original-edition support and Portcove qualification do not carry over. Research intake only. Upstream platforms: Official SourceForge Windows/Linux/macOS downloads and Flatpak. README documents Linux x86/x86-64/PPC/MIPS historical/source targets; selected artifact CPU is unknown until chosen. Original data: Own Baldur's GateII Enhanced Edition installed data for an experimentally supported GemRB build. This is separate from original BGII; exact EE revision/build compatibility remains to be established before offering operations. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
